sections.heading: What Our Engine Failure Repair Service Involves

blocks.html: When an engine has failed, our workshop follows a structured, methodical process to determine exactly what is needed and carry out the repair. This is not about why it happened - we focus on what needs to be done next.
Our service covers the full journey from assessment to completion:

items: **Initial inspection** - we examine the engine externally, check fluid condition, and verify the vehicle's VIN and engine code.
**Engine removal** - the engine is carefully lifted out of the vehicle, with all connections properly disconnected.
**Full strip-down** - the engine is dismantled completely, with every component labelled and laid out for inspection.
**Component-by-component inspection** - we check every part for wear, damage, or condition, measuring against factory tolerances.
**Quotation and authorisation** - we provide a detailed, itemised repair estimate before any work begins.
**Remediation and rebuild** - we machine, replace, and reassemble using genuine or OEM parts, to factory torque specifications.
**Testing and handover** - the rebuilt engine is tested, refitted, and road-tested before you collect your vehicle.

blocks.html: All work carries a **12-month unlimited-mileage warranty** on parts and labour.

sections.heading: Our Engine Failure Assessment & Remediation Process

steps.title: Initial Inspection
steps.body: We examine the engine externally, check fluid condition (oil, coolant), and verify the vehicle's VIN and engine code. We also check the air filter, oil filter, and visible components for any signs of distress.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: We drain all fluids, disconnect all systems (exhaust, wiring, fuel, cooling, transmission), and safely lift the engine from the vehicle using a professional hoist and lifting equipment.

steps.title: Full Strip-Down
steps.body: The engine is dismantled completely on the workshop bench. Every component is removed, labelled, and laid out systematically for inspection.

steps.title: Component Inspection & Measurement
steps.body: We inspect every part - cylinder head, block, pistons, rings, bearings, crankshaft, camshaft, timing components, and oil galleries. We measure wear against factory tolerances and identify what is salvageable and what must be replaced.

steps.title: Quotation & Authorisation
steps.body: We provide a detailed, itemised repair estimate showing the full scope of work, parts required, and labour. No work begins until you authorise the repair.

steps.title: Machining & Reconditioning
steps.body: Where needed, we machine cylinder bores, grind the crankshaft, resurface the cylinder head, and carry out any other precision engineering work to restore components to factory specifications.

steps.title: Reassembly & Fitting
steps.body: We reassemble the engine using genuine or OEM parts, with all fasteners tightened to the correct torque and sequence. We replace all seals, gaskets, and single-use components.

steps.title: Testing & Handover
steps.body: We refit the engine, fill with new fluids, perform a cold start, check oil pressure and temperature, run diagnostics, and carry out a full road test. Your vehicle is returned with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: What happens when my Mercedes-Benz engine has failed?
items.a: We start with an initial inspection, then remove the engine from the vehicle, strip it down completely, inspect every component, and provide a detailed repair estimate. Once you authorise the work, we machine, replace, and reassemble to factory standards, then test and return your vehicle.

items.q: How long does the assessment and repair process take?
items.a: The full process - from inspection to completion - typically takes 3-5 working days, depending on parts availability and the extent of the repair needed.

items.q: Do you provide a warranty on engine failure repairs?
items.a: Yes. All our engine failure repairs come with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.
Yes - we offer nationwide recovery from £70 (separate charge). We can arrange collection and delivery back to you.

items.q: What if the engine is beyond repair?
items.a: If the engine is not economically repairable, we will advise you on the best course of action - which may be a replacement engine. We can supply and fit a replacement unit as an alternative.

items.q: Do you use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts?
items.a: We use genuine or OEM-equivalent parts for all repairs, ensuring your engine meets factory specifications.
